name: Fabian Ortiz
source:
Fabian is Ortiz's studio CEO. He is very well known for bringing new artists to fame and for always being ahead of any studio.

He calculates every move to reach success and because of this people usually stay away from him, afraid they may get crushed.
However, not everything is as it seems. Under his serious nature, there's a real self being imprisoned. 

Fabian hates half-hearted people. For him, the world is made for those who seek victory. If you can't fight then you shouldn't even try.

Fabian is Ortiz's studio CEO. He is very well known for bringing new artists to fame and for always being ahead of any studio.

He calculates every move to reach success and because of this people usually stay away from him, afraid they may get crushed.

Fabian hates half-hearted people. For him, the world is made for those who seek victory. If you can't fight then you shouldn't even try.
